sermons.title: Sermon 3043 | Filling Up the Measure of Iniquity

scripture.verse: All hail the power of Jesus' name! Let angels prostrate fall. Bring forth the royal (diadem, And crown Him Lord of all!
scripture.reference: Crown Him, you martyrs of our God, Who from His altar call. Extol the stem of Jesse's rod, And crown Him Lord of all! You chosen seed of Israel's race, a remnant weak and small, Hail Him who saves you by His Grace, And crown Him Lord of all!
